nom: Cetaphil Nourishing Oil to Foam Cleanser Face Wash for Sensitive Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the cleanser as not leaving skin feeling oily or greasy, with several noting no new breakouts, though one found it left residue and didn't foam well.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report it cleans without stripping or tightness, leaving skin soft, moisturized and hydrated, with one exception noting slight dryness after washing.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including oily T-zones, report a balanced clean that doesn't leave skin tight or greasy.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or hypersensitive skin mostly report no burning, irritation or fragrance issues, but one reviewer with hypersensitive, reactive skin had a severe burning reaction requiring a steroid shot.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it as a gentle, hydrating option worth adding to a minimal routine for mature-leaning, long-term Cetaphil users, though no specific mature-skin outcome is detailed.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-oily skin uses it alongside their regular Cetaphil cleanser mainly to remove waterproof makeup.

concerns.aging: Only indirect mentions exist; one long-time Cetaphil user with a minimal routine calls it nourishing and worth adding, but no reviewer describes a concrete anti-aging effect.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry skin, report skin feels hydrated, soft and non-tight after use, with a few noting it locks in moisture; one reviewer still felt some dryness after washing.
concerns.redness: Reports are mixed: several sensitive-skin reviewers note no redness or stinging, but one reviewer experienced burning and facial redness lasting four days, attributed to a possible flaxseed allergy.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as maintaining or protecting the skin barrier, with skin feeling calm and not stripped after cleansing.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with cystic acne and hormonal breakouts reports smaller pores and less severe flare-ups over a month; another reports the product helped clear painful breakouts on the nose during double cleansing.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone or breakout-worried reviewers report no new breakouts and continued use without issues; however, one reviewer reports a purge with painful acne lasting weeks after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil and buildup without leaving a greasy after-feel, and does not increase oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Not a true oil cleanser as marketed

extraits.texte: This was a solid no for me! Followed the instructions, washed my face and eyes. In less than 2 hours my face was burning. I have hypersensitive skin that is very reactive. Been on the hunt for a gentle, fragrance free cleanser. I am not exactly sure what ingredients I am allergic too, but if I had to guess it's the flax seed. I had to go to urgent care to get a steroid shot. My face was red for 4 days from this cleanser.

This product caused my skin to purge. It started slowly, but after a week of using this product my face was covered in painful acne & its been WEEKS since! I keep struggling with break outs & my skin is not back to normal.

extraits.titre: Better than any oil I've tried
extraits.texte: This has surpassed my holy grail oil cleanser from D** brand. Ive tried seversl balms and oils and many didnt work well to rinse clean and actually take off my makeup. I glam every day so I need to double cleanse. This has become my HOLY GRAIL first step to double cleansing. I am acne prone and i havent expereinced any break outs since using this either. My skin is very sensitive and will react dramatically with products that are too harsh. However, I haven't experienced any burning, rashes or redness with this product. It doesnt strip my face dry however it does rinse clean (for an oil) i like how it works into a lather that sucks up all the makeup as you're rubbing it in. So you're basically creating a layer of makeup lather over your skin then your rinse away and it's clean! The makeup is gone and your skin is left clear and ready for your normal cleanser. I hope this never gets discontinued.

extraits.titre: Hyper Sensitive skin safe & it's affordable!
extraits.texte: 10/10 love this product! Doesn't have a scent as it is fragrance free but that's perfect for those with hyper sensitive skin! I've noticed over the month of using this product my pores have become smaller and I'm having less harsher breakouts. I'm on several medicines and my hormones normally have me having awful cystic acne or skin flare ups and using certain I've noticed increased healing and tightness. Overall I love this product and will continue to use and buy again and again! Definitely my new skincare holy grail! 😊

This cleanser has become my daily cleanser after trying Vanicream, Prequel, LRP, Cerave, Cetaphil... It cleans my oily combo skin super well but doesn't dry it out, yet is great for my adapelene-sensitized skin. No breakouts, no clogged pores, no irritation. And it removes makeup! PLEASE make this in a bigger size. I use it as body wash too! Amazing

I received this face wash free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this cleanser almost daily, and I really like how gentle it feels on my skin. It starts as a lightweight oil and then softens into a mild, milky foam once I add water, which makes removing my makeup and sunscreen easier. I have really dry skin, and it doesn't leave me feeling stripped or dry; instead, my skin feels hydrated and refreshed afterward. The texture is smooth and easy to work with, and I appreciate that it rinses off without leaving residue behind. I love that it doesn't have a strong, overpowering scent. It didn't irritate my skin at all. The pump is convenient and mess-free, which makes it easy to use, even on busy nights. It dispenses just the right amount of soap. I highly recommend this wash! ✨

I was looking for an oil cleanser but this just seemed like a normal foaming cleanser. Although it didn't even foam very well lol. My face did not feel very clean after using it and felt like there was still residue. I have sensitive, oily skin.
